m: शची f. the rendering of powerful or mighty help, assistance, aid (esp. said of the deeds of Indra and the Aśvins, instr. शच्या and शचीभिस्, often = ‘mightily’ or ‘helpfully’), RV.
kindness, favour, grace, ib.; AV.; AitBr.
skill, dexterity, RV.; VS.
speech, power of speech, eloquence, Naigh.

of the authoress of RV. x, 159 (having the patr. Paulomi), Anukr.

a kind of coitus, L.
